text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-san.
You mentioned going on an away trip...
after the Wakagoma Stakes, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Assuming our goal is the Kokura Kinen... um,
Trainer, have you already decided on the other races we'll run?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it's not quite like that.
It's just, you know..."

Nice Nature doubts her own abilities.
She just can't bring herself to be confident.
And that likely goes for any race she enters.

I can sense her anxiety from her averted gaze.
Even if she understands the situation logically, it's not something she can just brush aside. In that case—
choice_data_list: Somewhere with good sightseeing would be nice.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
choice_data_list: Since we're on an away trip and all...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
choice_data_list: I want to go on a tsukemono tour, so maybe Kyoto or somewhere like that

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
choice_data_list: And watching fireflies in Hyogo, among other things.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Pfft, ahahaha!
I see, you're right.
Yeah, yeah, it's a special away trip after all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good—pickles and fireflies.
In that case, we should match the race we enter to that...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Between Kyoto and Hanshin,
maybe the Kyoto Shimbun Hai and the Naruo Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, okay. I'll keep it in mind."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Let me know in advance next time, okay?
I'd like to look into the sights and tourist spots at least a little.
Setting our sights on the Kokura Kinen and entering the Kyoto Shimbun Hai and Naruo Kinen along the way might not be a bad idea.

If we can gain something from these races
to help Nice Nature build her confidence...
